description: This file defines iterator structures and methods for iterating over attribute sets in the OpenTelemetry Go SDK, including support for merging attribute sets and handling duplicates.

classes.name: Iterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing a set of attributes, sorted by key.

classes.name: MergeIterator
classes.description: Iterator for merging two attribute sets, resolving duplicates by precedence.

classes.name: oneIterator
classes.description: Helper struct for iterating over a single attribute set within MergeIterator.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next attribute, returning true if successful.

methods.name: Label
methods.description: Returns the current KeyValue; deprecated, use Attribute.

methods.name: Attribute
methods.description: Returns the current KeyValue of the iterator.

methods.name: IndexedLabel
methods.description: Returns current index and attribute; deprecated, use IndexedAttribute.

methods.name: Len
methods.description: Returns the number of attributes in the set.

methods.name: ToSlice
methods.description: Creates a slice of all attributes from the iterator.

methods.name: NewMergeIterator
methods.description: Creates a new MergeIterator for two attribute sets.

methods.name: makeOne
methods.description: Helper function to create a oneIterator from an Iterator.

methods.name: advance
methods.description: Advances a oneIterator to the next attribute.

methods.name: Next (for MergeIterator)
methods.description: Advances the merge iterator to the next attribute, resolving duplicates.

methods.name: Label (for MergeIterator)
methods.description: Returns the current attribute; deprecated, use Attribute.
